xBRIEFInfo.description: Fail closed when a closed scoped GitHub issue has no tracked xbrief/completed or cancelled artifact on the delivery branch tip. One check, one remediation (finalize-cohort or lifecycle PR). Skill-only #1358 is insufficient.

plan.title: bug(lifecycle,gates): completed xBRIEFs can remain untracked after merge (#1358 recurrence)

narratives.Description: Closed scoped GitHub issues can ship product on master while completed xBRIEFs remain untracked on a laptop. Release orphan-active and lifecycle sync stay green because they watch active residue not completed-but-not-tracked artifacts. This story adds one fail-closed land detector with one remediation path.
narratives.UserStory: As a swarm operator, I want a deterministic gate that fails when closed scoped work has no tracked completed xBRIEF on master, so that lifecycle hygiene is not left as untracked laptop residue.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: In packages/core/src add a fail-closed land check (prefer doctor check or packages/core/src/lifecycle or packages/core/src/swarm finalize helpers): given closed GitHub issue with x-xbrief/github-issue origin on a lifecycle xBRIEF, require a tracked path under xbrief/completed/ or xbrief/cancelled/ on delivery tip (git ls-tree or equivalent). Fail message names task swarm:finalize-cohort or lifecycle PR. Wire into doctor and/or release preflight if one line. Tests under packages/core/src/doctor or packages/core/src/lifecycle. Run pnpm exec vitest on touched packages and task check. Cite #3264 in CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased].
narratives.Overview: bug(lifecycle,gates): completed xBRIEFs can remain untracked after merge (#1358 recurrence)
narratives.NonGoals: Skill-only rewrite; multi-role DONE matrix v1; NLP; issues with no scope xBRIEF.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a closed scoped GitHub issue with a known lifecycle xBRIEF origin and no tracked completed or cancelled artifact on the delivery tip, when the detector runs, it exits non-zero and names finalize-cohort or a lifecycle PR as remediation.
Given the same issue after a tracked completed artifact exists on the delivery tip, when the detector runs, it does not fail for that issue.
Given a closed issue with no scope xBRIEF origin, when the detector runs, it does not false-positive as missing completed land.
Given the PR, when vitest and CHANGELOG are checked, tests cover fail and pass fixtures and [Unreleased] cites #3264.

verify_commands: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/doctor packages/core/src/swarm packages/core/src/lifecycle
